name: Seasons of the Earth
description: Six biomes through four seasons: tundra, boreal forest, temperate forest, grassland, desert and tropical rainforest, each heard in spring, summer, autumn and winter. Every sketch paints its place with ambiences, creatures and weather, and its season with key, tempo and texture: thaw and birdsong, long bright days, falling leaves and storms, then the hush of cold. In the rainforest, the seasons follow flowering, the monsoon, fruiting and the dry season.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Tundra · Spring Thaw
sketches.description: Meltwater drips off the ice, a stream finds its way and geese return far overhead, under glassy D lydian chords.

sketches.name: Tundra · Midnight Sun
sketches.description: The sun never sets: insects over the bogs, a plover calling, a herd on the move far off and a lilting folk tune in E major.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// The sun never sets: a bright pad that never quite comes to rest
pad: note("<[e3,b3,f#4] [c#3,g#3,e4] [a2,e3,b3] [b2,f#3,c#4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(sine.range(800, 2200).slow(16)).attack(1.5).release(3).room(.6).gain(.14)

// Insects swarming over the bogs, and a light wind
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(60).distance(2).gain(.14)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.08)

// A plover's call, and a herd on the move far off
plover: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(-50).distance(5).gain(.22)
herd: s("lt*4?0.5").speed(.8).lpf(400).distance(8).gain(.18)

// A lilting folk tune
tune: n("<[0 2 4 2] [5 4 2 ~] [4 5 7 5] [4@3 ~]>").scale("E:major").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.5).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Tundra · First Frost
sketches.description: The wind rises, cranes leave for the south and footsteps crunch on frozen moss while a choir sings slow A minor chords.

sketches.name: Tundra · Polar Night
sketches.description: Endless dark: a low drone, hissing snow and a cold wind, the aurora drifting overhead in slow glassy tones and sea ice cracking far away.
sketches.source:
setcpm(44/4)

// Polar night: a low drone under endless dark
drone: note("[c2,g2]").slow(8).s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(400).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.16)

// A cold wind and blowing snow
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.5).gain(.14)
snow: s("pink").slow(8).hpf(3000).lpf(7000).gain(.02)

// The aurora: slow, shimmering tones drifting across the sky
aurora: n(irand(8).segment(4)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.5).seed("aurora")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").attack(.8).decay(2).sustain(0).release(3)
  .pan(sine.slow(16)).delay(.5).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.5)
  .room(.9).size(.95).gain(.1)

// Ice cracking far out on the frozen sea
ice: s("~ ~ ~ creak").mask("<0 0 1 0 0 0 0 0>").speed(.5).distance(9).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Boreal Forest · Snowmelt Woods
sketches.description: A stream runs high with snowmelt, a woodpecker drums in the pines and a cuckoo calls while a fiddle greets the returning light.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// The stream runs high with snowmelt
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.22)

// A woodpecker drumming somewhere in the pines
woodpecker: s("rim*8 ~ ~ ~").mask("<1 0 0 1 0 0 0 0>").speed(2).lpf(3000).azimuth(70).distance(6).gain(.2)

// A cuckoo: the falling third of spring
cuckoo: note("<[~ ~ e5 c5] ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.3).distance(5).room(.5).gain(.2)

// A fiddle tune for the returning light, over a picked guitar
fiddle: note("<[g4 b4 d5 b4] [c5 b4 a4 g4] [a4 b4 c5 d5] [b4@2 a4 g4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(2800).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.03).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.2).room(.4).gain(.2)
guitar: note("<[g2,d3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3] [d3,a3,d4,f#4] [g2,d3,g3,b3]>")
  .struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.3).pan(.4).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Boreal Forest · Loon Lake
sketches.description: Long evenings by a northern lake: lapping water, insects in the reeds, a loon wailing across the water and a gentle guitar in A.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// Water lapping at the shore, insects in the reeds
lake: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.15).gain(.14)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(90).distance(3).gain(.12)

// A loon calling across the lake: a slow, gliding wail
loon: note("<[a4@2 e5@6] ~ [e5@3 c#5 e5@4] ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(1).glide(.3).vib(4).vibdepth(.2)
  .attack(.2).sustain(.7).release(1).distance(8).room(.8).gain(.16)

// A warm pad and a picked guitar: A, F#m, D, E
pad: note("<[a2,e3,c#4] [f#2,c#3,a3] [d3,a3,f#4] [e3,b3,g#4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(1400).attack(1).release(2).room(.6).gain(.14)
guitar: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4").add("<0 0 5 5 3 3 4 4>").scale("A:major")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.4).pan(.4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Boreal Forest · Larch Gold
sketches.description: Golden larches in light rain: a bull elk bugles across the valley, leaves tick down, a cello holds the roots and a piano wanders in D dorian.
sketches.source:
setcpm(68/4)

// Light rain and wind in the treetops
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.25).gain(.18)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.1)

// A bull elk bugling across the valley
elk: note("<[d4 a5@4 g5] ~ ~ ~>").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").mono(1).glide(.2)
  .lpf(2500).attack(.1).sustain(.6).release(.6).distance(8).room(.7).gain(.12)

// Larch needles ticking down
leaves: s("click*16?0.2").hpf(2500).pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.02, .06))

// A cello holds the roots while a piano wanders
cello: note("<d2 c2 bb1 a1>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08)
  .lpf(700).attack(.8).sustain(.7).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.2)
piano: n("<[0 ~ 2 4] [3 ~ 2 ~] [1 ~ 0 ~] [4@2 3 2]>").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("larch")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(1).sustain(.1).release(1.2)
  .room(.6).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Boreal Forest · Snow Under Spruce
sketches.description: Footsteps in deep snow, wind muffled by the spruce, an owl hooting from the dark and a hushed choir under falling bell-flakes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(54/4)

// Wind muffled by the spruce, and footsteps in deep snow
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.3).occlude(.4).gain(.12)
steps: s("step ~ step ~").lpf(1200).gain(.14)

// An owl hooting from deep in the trees
owl: note("<[~ ~ d4 [d4 a3]] ~ ~ ~>").s("hum").attack(.05).release(.5).distance(7).room(.7).gain(.18)

// A hushed choir: Dm, Bb, Gm, A
choir: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3] [a2,c#3,e3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo oo ah oo>")
  .attack(2).release(3).space("hall").gain(.2)

// Snowflakes: high bells, a few at a time
bells: note("<[a5 ~ f5 ~] [~ d5 ~ ~] [~ ~ e5 ~] [c#5 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("spruce")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76).decay(2).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).space("hall").gain(.07)

sketches.name: Temperate Forest · Bluebell Morning
sketches.description: Headphones on: a dawn chorus placed all around you, a soft shower, a pastoral flute and a harp in C major.
sketches.source:
setcpm(92/4)

// The dawn chorus, placed around the listener
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.3)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(50).elevation(20).distance(4).gain(.24)
thrush: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(140).distance(6).gain(.18)

// A soft spring shower
shower: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(.1)

// A flute over a harp: C, F, Am, G
flute: note("<[c5@2 d5 e5 g5@3 e5] [f5@2 e5 d5 c5@4] [a4 c5 d5 e5 d5@2 c5 a4] [g4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.5)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.26)
harp: note("<[c3 e3 g3 e3] [f3 a3 c4 a3] [a2 c3 e3 c3] [g2 b2 d3 b2]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Temperate Forest · Green Canopy
sketches.description: A lazy afternoon under thick leaves: insects, a brook and an oriole flitting overhead, with a soft swung groove and Rhodes chords in F.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// Insects on one side, a brook on the other
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(-90).distance(3).gain(.12)
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(40).distance(4).gain(.16)

// An oriole flitting through the canopy
oriole: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(saw.range(-60, 60).slow(8)).elevation(30).distance(5).posglide(.3).gain(.2)

// A soft, swung kit
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ rim ~ rim, hh*8").swing(4).lpf(4000).gain(.4)

// Rhodes chords and a round bass: Fmaj7, Dm7, Bbmaj7, C7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,bb3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).lpf(2400).room(.4).gain(.28)
bass: note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.45)

sketches.name: Temperate Forest · Falling Leaves
sketches.description: An autumn waltz in A minor: gusting wind, leaves skittering past, a far-off crow and a bowed melody over guitar.
sketches.source:
setcpm(78/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4
// Gusting wind, leaves skittering past and a light rain
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.4).gain(.14)
leaves: s("click*12?0.3").hpf(2000).pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.02, .07))
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(.12)
crow: s("bird").slow(6).azimuth(-70).distance(7).gain(.14)

// Guitar waltz: Am, F, Dm, E
guitar: note("<[a2 [c3,e3] [c3,e3]] [f2 [a2,c3] [a2,c3]] [d3 [f3,a3] [f3,a3]] [e2 [g#2,b2] [g#2,b2]]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.3).gain(.26)

// A bowed melody falling like the leaves
melody: note("<[e4 a4 c5] [c5@2 a4] [f4 a4 d5] [b4 g#4 e4] [a4 c5 e5] [d5@2 c5] [f4 e4 d4] [g#4@2 b4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.1).lpf(2200)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Temperate Forest · Bare Branches
sketches.description: Inside by the fire while wind moves through bare branches outside: a sparse piano in G minor, soft chords and a winter robin at the window.
sketches.source:
setcpm(58/4)

// The fire inside, the wind outside the window
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.3).density(6).gain(.22)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.3).occlude(.6).gain(.1)

// A winter robin, heard through the glass
robin: s("bird").slow(8).azimuth(60).distance(6).occlude(.5).gain(.12)

// Sparse piano over soft chords: Gm, Eb, Cm, D
piano: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ ~] [5 ~ ~ 4] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("G:minor").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("branches")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(2)
  .room(.6).gain(.26)
chords: note("<[g2,d3,bb3] [eb2,bb2,g3] [c3,g3,eb4] [d2,a2,f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(1).sustain(.5).release(3)
  .lpf(900).room(.6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Grassland · Prairie Bloom
sketches.description: Wind in the new grass and a meadowlark singing, with a banjo roll, a fiddle and a bouncing bass in D.
sketches.source:
setcpm(108/4)

// Wind in the new grass and a meadowlark singing
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.25).gain(.1)
meadowlark: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-60).distance(4).gain(.28)

// A banjo roll through D, G, A, D
banjo: n("0 4 7 9 7 4 2 4").add("<0 3 4 0>").scale("D:major")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.35).gain(.24)

// The fiddle tune
fiddle: note("<[a4@2 b4 d5 e5@3 d5] [g5@2 f#5 e5 d5@4] [a4@2 b4 a4 f#4@3 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3000).vib(6).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2).pan(.6).room(.4).gain(.2)

// A bouncing bass and brushes
bass: note("<[d2 a1]*2 [g1 d2]*2 [a1 e2]*2 [d2 a1]*2>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.4)
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ rim ~ rim").lpf(3000).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Grassland · Thunderhead
sketches.description: Eight cycles of a summer storm on the plains: heat and insects, gathering wind, thunder and rain, then the air clearing.

sketches.name: Grassland · Harvest Moon
sketches.description: A bonfire after the harvest: crickets in the stubble, a strummed guitar and a harmonica crying the blues in A.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// Crickets in the stubble, a bonfire crackling
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(5).gain(.1)
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.3).density(8).gain(.18)

// A strummed guitar: A, D, A, E
guitar: note("<[a2,e3,a3,c#4] [d3,a3,d4,f#4] [a2,e3,a3,c#4] [e2,b2,e3,g#3]>")
  .struct("x ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ [~ x] ~")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.3).pan(.4).gain(.24)
bass: note("<a1 d2 a1 e2>").struct("x ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.4)

// The harmonica under the harvest moon
harp: n("<[~ 4 [5 4] 3] [2 0 ~ ~] [~ 3 [4 3] 2] [0 ~ ~ ~]>").scale("A:blues").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o")
  .mono(1).glide(.05).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.3)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.65).room(.4).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Grassland · Wind over the Steppe
sketches.description: A frozen steppe: a hard wind and blowing snow, overtone singing, a horse-head fiddle and hooves trotting through the drifts.

sketches.name: Desert · Superbloom
sketches.description: After rare rain the desert flowers: drips from the cactus, bees in the blossoms, a wren, and an oud and flute in bright E lydian.
sketches.source:
setcpm(88/4)

// The last drops of a rare rain, bees in the blossoms, a cactus wren
drips: s("drip*8?0.4").pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.04, .12))
bees: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(40).distance(2).gain(.1)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(-50).distance(4).gain(.24)

// A reedy drone and a bright oud figure
drone: note("[e2,b2]").slow(4).s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(600).attack(1).sustain(1).release(2).gain(.14)
oud: note("<[e3 f#3 g#3 a#3 b3 a#3 g#3 f#3] [e3 ~ b3 ~ g#3 f#3 e3 ~]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.4).gain(.26)

// A flute opening like a flower
flute: n("<[4@3 5] [6@2 4 2] [7@4] [4@2 2 0]>").scale("E:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.4)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Desert · Mirage
sketches.description: Midday heat: hot wind and cicadas, a darbuka in maqsum, a wavering pad like heat over sand and an ornamented ney.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Hot wind and cicadas
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.4).gain(.14)
cicadas: s("insect").slow(2).azimuth(70).distance(3).gain(.12)

// Maqsum on the darbuka
darbuka: s("lt rim ~ rim lt ~ rim ~").lpf(2500).room(.3).gain(.45)

// A mirage: a pad that wavers like heat over the sand
mirage: note("[e3,b3,f4]").slow(4).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4)
  .vib(3).vibdepth(.15).lpf(sine.range(600, 1800).slow(8))
  .attack(2).release(3).room(.7).gain(.12)

// A ney flute in E phrygian dominant: e f g# a b c d
ney: note("<[e4@2 f4 g#4 a4@4] [b4@3 a4 g#4@2 f4 e4] [c5@2 b4 a4 g#4@4] [f4 e4 f4 g#4 e4@4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("reed").mono(1).glide(.07).vib(5).vibdepth(.25)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.7).release(.4)
  .pan(.6).delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Desert · Dust Devils
sketches.description: Headphones on: gusts across the mesa, a dust devil spinning around your head, a coyote far away and a twangy guitar in A minor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// Gusts across the mesa
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.45).gain(.14)

// A dust devil spinning around your head
dustdevil: s("pink*16").hpf(800).lpf(3000)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(3).posglide(.3)
  .attack(.05).release(.1).gain(.05)

// A coyote howling far across the desert
coyote: note("<[~ a4 e5@4 c5 a4] ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(1).glide(.25).vib(5).vibdepth(.3)
  .attack(.1).sustain(.6).release(.6).distance(9).room(.8).gain(.14)

// A twangy guitar: Am, G, F, E
guitar: note("<[a2 e3 a3 c4 e4 c4 a3 e3] [g2 d3 g3 b3 d4 b3 g3 d3] [f2 c3 f3 a3 c4 a3 f3 c3] [e2 b2 e3 g#3 b3 g#3 e3 b2]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.4)
  .lpf(2400).delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.24)

// A lonesome horn over the chords
horn: note("<[e4@3 a4 c5@4] [b4@2 a4 g4 a4@4] [c5@3 b4 a4@2 f4 e4] [e4@8]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(2000).vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.5).room(.7).gain(.16)

sketches.name: Desert · Cold Stars
sketches.description: A clear, freezing desert night: a small fire, a still drone, stars twinkling in random high notes and a slow oud in D.
sketches.source:
setcpm(52/4)

// A small fire and a faint, cold wind
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.25).density(4).gain(.18)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.15).gain(.06)

// A still drone on D and A
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(8).s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(500).attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.14)

// Stars: a few random high notes twinkling in the delay
stars: n(irand(10).segment(16)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.8).seed("stars")
  .s("sine").decay(.1).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .pan(rand).delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.8).gain(.1)

// A slow oud by the fire
oud: note("<[d3 ~ f3 g3] [a3@2 g3 f3] [e3 f3 e3 c3] [d3@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.6)
  .room(.6).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Rainforest · Canopy in Flower
sketches.description: The flowering season: birds and parrots high in the canopy, frogs clicking below, a bright marimba and hand drums in G.

sketches.name: Rainforest · Monsoon
sketches.description: The wet season: a downpour on the leaves, water dripping everywhere, rolling thunder and a deep, slow groove in D minor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)

// A downpour, and water dripping from every leaf
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.8).gain(.3)
drips: s("drip*16?0.5").pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.05, .15)).space("outdoor")

// Thunder rolling over the canopy
thunder: s("<~ ~ [~ lt] ~ ~ ~ lt ~>").speed(.5).lpf(250).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.45)

// A deep, slow groove of low drums
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~, ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~, ht ~ mt ~ ~ lt ~ ~").lpf(2000).room(.3).gain(.4)

// A heavy pad and bass: Dm7, Bbmaj7, Gm7, A7
pad: note("<[d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3] [a2,c#3,e3,g3]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 1400).slow(8)).attack(1).release(2).room(.7).gain(.14)
bass: note("<d2 bb1 g1 a1>").slow(2).struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.42)

sketches.name: Rainforest · Fruiting Season
sketches.description: Trees heavy with fruit: howler monkeys roaring at dusk, a toucan, insects, and a playful marimba over hand drums in A minor.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)

// Insects, a toucan, and howler monkeys calling across the treetops
insects: s("insect").slow(2).azimuth(-80).distance(3).gain(.12)
toucan: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(50).elevation(30).distance(5).gain(.2)
howlers: note("<~ [a2@2 e3@6] ~ ~>").s("aah").attack(.3).release(1).distance(8).room(.7).gain(.18)

// A playful marimba: Am, Am, Dm, G
marimba: note("[a3 ~ c4 e4] [~ g4 e4 ~] [d4 ~ c4 a3] [~ e4 ~ g4]").add("<0 0 5 -2>")
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.3).sustain(0).pan(.35).room(.3).gain(.24)

// Hand drums and shakers, and a bouncing bass
perc: s("lt rim [~ lt] rim, hh*8?0.4").sometimesBy(.2, x => x.ply(2)).room(.3).gain(.38)
bass: note("<a1 a1 d2 g1>").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(700).lpq(3).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.4)

sketches.name: Rainforest · Dry Season Dawn
sketches.description: The dry season: morning mist, a low stream, gibbons singing their rising duet and a plucked line in E minor pentatonic.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)

// Morning mist, a low stream and a few insects
mist: s("pink").slow(8).hpf(400).lpf(1200).gain(.04)
stream: s("stream").slow(4).intensity(.2).distance(5).gain(.16)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.06)

// Gibbons singing their rising dawn duet
gibbons: note("<[e4 g4 a4 b4 d5 e5@2 ~] ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(1).glide(.12).vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.4).distance(7).room(.7).gain(.16)

// A plucked line over a quiet drone
pluck: n("<[0 ~ 2 ~] [4 ~ ~ 2] [3 ~ 1 ~] [0@4]>").scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.6)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.22)
drone: note("[e2,b2]").slow(8).s("sine").attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.16)
